title: thelypteris pittsfordensis
intro: Thelypteris pittsfordensis, commonly known as Pittsford fern, is a species of fern in the family Thelypteridaceae. It is a type of vascular plant that belongs to the division Pteridophyta, characterized by its leafy fronds and ability to photosynthesize. The health benefits of Thelypteris pittsfordensis include its antioxidant and anti-inflammatory properties, which may help to protect against cell damage and reduce inflammation in the body. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions such as antimicrobial and antiseptic properties.
